title: LevelObservation
description: One height value read from one place in the drawings, tagged with which of the four ADR-0003 height fields it is. Observations are never merged across `kind`: an `SL` read from an elevation and a `CH` read from a level table describe different things and must not be compared for equality. Reconciliation into per-floor values happens in floor-levels.schema.json.

value_mm.description: Millimetres. `SL` and `FL` are elevations relative to the project datum and may be negative; `FLOOR_HEIGHT` and `CH` are distances and are positive.

evidence.description: Entities the value was read from. Required to be non-empty unless `source` is `USER` (CLAUDE.md rule 6).

raw_text.description: Text exactly as it appears in the drawing, before parsing, NFC normalised. Empty string when the source is `USER`.

floor_label.description: Floor label the observation was attached to, as printed in the drawing, e.g. `3F`, `B1`, `PH`.

evidence_rule.title: LevelObservationEvidenceRule
evidence_rule.description: CLAUDE.md rule 6: everything but a hand-entered value must point at the entities it came from. Carries no fields of its own.
